struggles.overview: Type 1 leaders see the importance of setting clear goals and demonstrating to others how to reach their greatest potential.
struggles.description: This is who you call when you need someone to look over your work and bring it to the next level.

struggle: Carries Grudges On Behalf of Others
struggles.overview: Type 2 leaders take on the responsibility of assessing the overall health of the team members in order to adapt organizational goals for maximum accomplishments.
struggles.description: This is who you call when you need to be told how loved and valuable you are.

struggles.overview: Type 3 leaders are over-achievers who set up their team members for accomplishable successes around a common organizational goal.
struggles.description: This is who you call when you have an idea but aren’t sure how you’re going to make it work.

struggle: Resists Criticism, But Critical of Others
struggles.overview: Type 4 leaders seek to associate meaning and purpose with their organizations in order to inspire team members to be excellent employees.
struggles.description: This is who you call when you want to be accepted just as you are without fear of judgement.

struggles.overview: Type 5 leaders develop efficiency though research and planning where each team member knows how they fit and can independently work toward the common goal.
struggles.description: This is who you call when you need an innovative solution to your problem.

struggles.overview: AversiveType 6 leaders establish open environments where team members contributeand each feels part of both the developing process as well as the resolution of challenges.
struggles.description: This is who you call when you need help thinking through possible outcomes.

struggles.overview: Type 7 leaders generate excitement for new prospects sweeping team members into the energetic flow for optimizing every possible opportunity.
struggles.description: This is who you call when you need help believing it’s all going to work out and/or permission to do what you want to do anyway.

struggles.overview: Type 8 leaders push forward by attracting accomplished, highly-qualified team members and empowering them to take action toward the common objectives.
struggles.description: This is who you call when you need honest feedback on who you are as a person and where you should/shouldn’t be putting your energy.

struggles.overview: Type 9 leaders bring team members together to work toward a mutually beneficial goal through harmonious collaboration.
struggles.description: This is who you call when you need someone to understand your perspective.
